description:
Cast Chronozoa by paying {3}{U}. It will enter without a time counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Chronozoa enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Chronozoa.
When Chronozoa dies, it triggers, creating two token copies of itself that also enter with no time counters on them due to Solemnity.
When the Chronozoa tokens enter, Blasting Station triggers twice, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 3.
Repeat from step 3 using a token copy of Chronozoa instead.
